  4. Rainbow Bridge, Utah - The largest natural arch, accessible by boat or a 14-mile roundtrip hike.
  5. Devil's Tower, Wyoming - An iconic rock formation rising 867 feet.
  6. Cahokia Mounds, Illinois - Preserves the remains of a pre-Columbian city.
